content.text:
Needed: An ATX power supply with enough SATA power leads for the drives for Family photo NAS from the ASRock board
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 220 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "for parts", "dead", "no power", "SFX", "TFX", "Flex ATX", "1U server", "no SATA"], "pattern": "atx.{0,20}(psu|power supply).{0,20}sata", "phrasings": [{"text": "ATX power supply", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ATX+power+supply", "why": "Finds standard listings using the full plain name that abbreviate nothing."}, {"text": "ATX PSU", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ATX+PSU", "why": "Finds sellers who shorten power supply to PSU and skip the long name."}, {"text": "computer power supply SATA", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=computer+power+supply+SATA", "why": "Finds listings focused on SATA leads for drives rather than saying ATX."}, {"text": "desktop modular PSU", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=desktop+modular+PSU", "why": "Finds modular desktop units with many drive cables that omit ATX in title."}, {"text": "NAS power supply ATX", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=NAS+power+supply+ATX", "why": "Finds units listed specifically for NAS builds with enough SATA leads."}]}
